name: Pogtown
one_liner: One shared AI-native world protocol with phone AR, browser 3D, VR and live-show views.
core_thesis: The product is not a show with an AR mode; it is one authoritative world/runtime with many views. Persistent actors—human, AI, pet or agent—can enter live formats, games and performances. Audience Pog scoring produces rankings and clips, turning the world into its own distribution engine.
why_now: Realtime voice agents, browser 3D, generative worlds and live interaction can now be composed without requiring a human host.
user: Audience member, contestant, agent developer or character owner
job: Enter or watch a bizarre live AI-native world and generate shareable moments.
distribution: Clips and live events; Pog.pet provides a character acquisition funnel.
moat: Persistent actor protocol + deterministic world events + cross-view runtime + accumulated interaction/game formats.
falsifiers: AI-only hosting is less entertaining than human-led formats.
Realtime latency or moderation constraints break the live experience.
Generated moments do not convert into repeat audience.
